sections.content: You know every part of this discussion from the unit: the imperfect and present perfect with time markers, the future and *probablemente*, necessity + subjunctive and the verbs of change. Now put them together to say what changed, what will happen and what has to change.

items.spanish: Antes la situación era diferente, pero actualmente ha cambiado mucho.
items.english: The situation was different before, but it has changed a lot now.

items.spanish: Probablemente seguirá evolucionando durante los próximos años.
items.english: It will probably continue evolving over the next few years.

items.spanish: Es necesario que nos adaptemos a estos cambios.
items.english: It is necessary for us to adapt to these changes.

items.spanish: El desarrollo presenta desafíos, pero también ofrece nuevas oportunidades.
items.english: Development presents challenges, but it also offers new opportunities.

sections.content: An effective discussion connects past change, present conditions, future predictions and evaluation.
